_doc: Clips that show soldier work and routine, and the poses no clip shows (tools/bt/life/build_poses.py). Listing a pose claims nothing about 1863: the evidence rows say what was done, where and by whom. P1 = an activity the plan or the record already names or that every camp scene needs; P2 = needed when a row names it. A pose is authored only when at least one evidence row names it in pose_needed (demand counted by build_poses.py --demand).

activity_clips.label: Digging with a spade / shovel (earthworks are built on screen, plan B.7)
activity_clips.limits: spade only; one digging motion for earth work, burial and gun pits (no pick, no throwing up, no tamping)

activity_clips.label: Chopping with an axe (felling timber for log works)
activity_clips.limits: axe only, one chopping motion (no saw, no trimming limbs, no splitting)

activity_clips.label: carrying a rail on the shoulder
activity_clips.limits: a single man with a rail on the shoulder; walks at 0.85 m/s (no two-man carry, no throwing down)

activity_clips.label: Lifting a stone and setting it in a wall (lay stone breastworks)
activity_clips.limits: lift and set one stone; no carrying, no prying; also the nearest clip for stacking rails and logs

activity_clips.label: Sitting on the ground at a fire (hands to the warmth, head turning)
activity_clips.limits: seated at a fire, hands to the warmth, head turning (no tending, no eating, no writing)

activity_clips.label: Cooking: stirring a pot over a fire
activity_clips.limits: standing or crouched stirring one pot with a ladle (no frying, no coffee, no kettle carry)

activity_clips.label: Drinking (cup / canteen to the mouth)
activity_clips.limits: cup or canteen to the mouth, one shot, not looped (no filling a vessel)

activity_clips.label: Eating (right hand to the mouth, chewing)
activity_clips.limits: hand to mouth and chewing (posture not stated by the clip name: check before use for a seated meal)

activity_clips.label: Sleeping on the side (breathing)
activity_clips.limits: sleeping on the side, breathing (no supine, no sitting asleep, no pairs)

activity_clips.label: Standing picket (alert, head scanning, rifle at order arms)
activity_clips.limits: standing alert, head scanning, rifle at order arms (no pacing, no challenge, no kneeling)

activity_clips.label: rest / at ease (no silence or steadiness required)
activity_clips.limits: rest or at ease; documented in the drill manual (the standing rest, not a seated rest)

activity_clips.label: Orderly carrying a bucket (loop)
activity_clips.limits: orderly carrying a bucket (hospital role); usable as a stand-in for a water carry until a canteen carry exists

activity_clips.label: Drummer beating (alternate sticks; the beat names are Casey HCS-L04)
Bugler sounds a call (bugle to the lips)
Horse-holder (dismounted, holds the reins of the horses)
Officer points (left arm extended, the sword stays in the right hand)
Officer speaks to the men (head turns, left hand gestures)
Colour-bearer standing with the colours (breeze: small sway)
